title: Kitchen Reminder Ribbon
summary: Adds an accessible, rotating reminder ribbon beneath the main navigation.
behavior: Shows the highest-priority current kitchen reminder beneath the main navigation.
Rotates reminders every nine seconds and pauses on hover, focus, reduced-motion preference, or user request.
Links directly to backup, meal planning, shopping, refrigerator, frozen inventory, and weekend bulk planning pages.
Allows a one-day snooze or a visit-only hide without permanently disabling backup reminders.
